system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing health of a Lambda-based API (invocations, errors, throttles, duration)

Parameters:
  FunctionName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the Lambda function to monitor
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid Lambda function name.

  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Dashboard
    Default: LambdaApiHealthDashboard
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Dashboard name.

  ErrorAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Error count threshold over evaluation period before alarm triggers
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1

  ThrottleAlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Throttle count threshold over evaluation period before alarm triggers
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1

  DurationAlarmThresholdMs:
    Type: Number
    Description: Average duration (ms) threshold before alarm triggers
    Default: 3000
    MinValue: 1

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications (leave blank to skip subscription)
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address or empty.

Conditions:
  HasEmailSubscription: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-health-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub 'Lambda API Health Alarms - ${FunctionName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sns
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: LambdaApiHealthMonitoring

  AlarmTopicEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  LambdaErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Errors exceeded threshold for Lambda function ${FunctionName}'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ErrorAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  LambdaThrottlesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-Throttles'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Throttles detected for Lambda function ${FunctionName}'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Throttles
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref FunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleAlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  LambdaDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${FunctionName}-HighDuration'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Average duration exceeded threshold for Lambda function ${FunctionName}'
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref Funct
